༄༅/ /snyan brgyud gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snyan brgyud gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so/ /

na mo gu ru/ skye med 'gags med rgyal ba'i yum/ /bde chen ngang nas ṭāk+ki ma/ /dri med thugs sprul lab sgron mar/ /sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgos med zhen log gter la spyod/ /mi zad 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug / ma nor lam mchog ston mdzad pa'i/ /pha yid bzhin nor bu'i zhabs la 'dud/ / snyan rgyud gdams ngag bdud rtsi 'di/ /brag seng ge gdong gi mtha' rtsa ru/ /ma cig sangs rgyas lab sgron gyis/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bshams/ /rgyal ba'i yum la gsol ba btab/ /yum sprul rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ /dngos su ma cig yum la gnang*/ /yum gyis thod smyon la sogs nas/ /pha 'dod ston rgyal po yan chad la/ /snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yin/ /ma lnga bu brgya sum cu 'di/ / gser 'phrang zhal gdams bco brgyad dang*/ /rin chen sgron me skor gsum dang*/ /zab don thugs kyi 'phrul gcod dang*/ /nying chog le lag brgyad ma dang*// rig pa 'phrul gyi lde mig la/ /blo dman 'dul phyir thor bu yod/ khrig chags tshang ba'i yig ris med/ /snyan rgyud gsal ba'i me long 'di/ /dad can rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /yi dam ma cig sangs rgyas dang*/ /ṭāk+ki'i tshogs la gsol ba gdab/ /srod la ṭāk+ki'i tshogs 'dus nas/ /dung dkar g.yas g.yon dbus gsum bsgrags/ /dngos su skyes bus dung bus gsungs/ / rkang gling blangs nas thebs se bus/ /tho rangs bud med mdzes ma gsum/ / byung nas shog ldeb bcu gsum dang*/ /zho phor gang gnang mkha' la 'phur/ / brda ru go nas bris pa la/ /ma gcig sangs rgyas lab sgron dang*/ /ṭāk+ki'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ / dang po gnyan khrod 'grims pa'i dus/ /lus 'di ro yi tshul du 'gro / rig pa ro khur tshul du dmigs/ /gnyan sa dur khrod tshul du bsam/ /lha 'dre lce spyang tshul du dmigs/ /slebs nas dmigs pa 'di gsum bya/ /gtong phod blo skyur che ba ni/

/lus la ma chags ltos med yin/ /stong nyid rgyab tshan che ba ni/ / skye med rtog med ngang la bzhag /nyams len zhe phug che ba ni/ /yengs med snyems med brtson 'grus gces/ /'di rgyun gyi dmigs pa rnam gsum yin/ /blo dman sngon 'gro'i dmigs pa ni/ /rang nyid tha mal yod pa yi/ /spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*/ /ma gcig bskyed pa'i sku las ni/ /bdud rtsi byung nas rang lus gang*/ /rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib rnams/ /lha 'dre rnams la nag 'gyed bya/ / mang byas mthar ni lus yang 'gyel/ /dga' mgur gyur nas rang sar yal/ / skye med stong pa'i ngang la bzhag / de nas dkar tshogs dmigs pa ni/ /dang po ltos bcas byed pa la/ /rang lus tsho snum bar snang khengs/ /de'i steng zil gnon nam mkha' khengs/ /de nas 'ching byed sa gzhi khengs/ /'dren lugs bla ma'i zhal las shes/ / phyogs med gnyan khrod 'grim pa'i dus/ /'gro lugs rnams bzhi shes pa gces/ /de yang dpa' bo'i stangs 'gros ni/ khro bo stobs chen 'gyings nas 'gro/ /mi mthong lha 'dre 'ded par dmigs/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lding 'gros ni/ /lam gyi so pa gzir gyin 'gro/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gar 'gros ni/ /lha 'dre lus la bstims kyin 'gro/ /sbrul nag 'khyil 'gros bya ba ni/ /sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad kyi/ /gnas dang bcas pa gnyan sar khyer/ /'dra ba gsum gyi man ngag la/ /snga ma snga ru ma non na/ /dgra ngan dag la bya shor 'dra/ / bar pa bar du ma non na/ /dpa' bo'i lag gi mtshon shor 'dra/ /phyi ma phyi ru ma non na/ /nor gyi phyi la rjes 'ded 'dra/ /zhes pas zil gnon gtong ba yin/ /de yang dmigs pa drug tu yod/ /ri la seng ge zil gnon btang*/ /brag la gser gyi rdo rje btang*/ /chu mtshor me yi bya khyung btang*/ /lam dang thang la rdo rje bsnol/ /phug pa lha khang mchod rten la/ /thu lum 'bar bas mnan par bya/ / lung stong thang chen brag ri

sa bcad/ /bar ma do la khyer ba yin/ /phyi ma yar mar mi ga mthong sar/ /tho brtsegs snying kha'i bya khyung bzhag /de rnams gnad kyi dmigs pa yin/ / da ni gzhung lnga'i dang po la/ /skyabs gnas dam pa sum brtsegs ni/ /rang lus stong gsum gang ba'i steng*/ /gdan bzhi ro mgo g.yon bstan dbus/ / rdo rje rnal 'byor sku mdog dmar/ /gri gug thod khrag gar stabs bzhugs/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum g.yon bskum ma/ kha ṭ+waṃ sked pa bha ga dang*/ /rting pas ro yi pho rtags mnan/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu brgyan cing*/ / rlon pa'i do shal rgyan drug gsol/ /g.yas su dam pa dmar smug la/ /mgul du gser gyi rgyan drug gsol/ /skyil krung cang te'u rkang gling 'dzin/ /sha zur spyan rtsa dmar la 'khrug /g.yon na ma gcig ḍā dril bsnams/ /pha rgyud ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /grangs las 'das pas bskor nas bzhugs/ /de steng gzhu 'dom gang gi sar/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /bstan pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas bskyed/ /de steng gdan gsum steng du ni/ /yum chen gsang sngags lha tshogs bskyed/ /de nas rig pa snying gar bsdu/ /dhu ti spyi bor zang thal dmigs/ /phaṭa kyis rig pa ṭāk+kir bstims/ /ṭāk+ki ma yi thugs ka nas/ / las kyi ṭāk+ki byung nas su/ /mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum btsugs nas /yum chen phog nas de steng bkal/ /'bru gsum brjod pas rgya cher bskyed/ /bem po gri gug de yis gshags/ /snying blang gtor ma'i tshul du bya/ /sha khrag rus gsum gtor mar brgyan/ /thab 'og yaṃ raṃ rlung me g.yos/ /bdud rtsi ra khol nas 'phyur ba dang*/ /las mkhan gri gug theng gsum dkrug /lbu ba mi gtsang ljan ljin bor/ /dngas ma steng gi lha tshogs kyi/ /'od kyi sbu gus gsol bar bsam// de nas ṭāk+ki dpag med sprul/ /rigs drug mgron ltar yod pa la/ /'dod dgu dpag med bkye bar bsam/ /sgyed gsum yi ge gsum du gyur/

/thod par thims pas a ru gyur/ /a dang rigs drug ṭāk+kir thim/ /mgo bo 'bum yang ṭāk+kir thim/ /ṭāk+ki gtso mo nyid la thim/ /gtso mo'i 'khor yang gtso la thim/ / yum chen 'khor rnams yum la thim/ /yum ni thub pa nyid la thim/ /thub pa'i 'khor rnams thub pa la'o/ /de yang rnal 'byor ma la thim/ /rnal 'byor ma yang 'ja' yal ltar/ /phaṭa kyis skye med ngang la bzhag /bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab/ / ༈ bem bskyur ma yi dmigs pa ni/ /bdag lus shin tu che bar bsam/ / mgo rkang lung pa'i phu mdo khengs/ /gzhogs kyis lung pa'i g.yas g.yon mnan/ /gsang gnas dag nas spyi bo'i bar/ /rtsa gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dang*/ /dbus mthing mda' smyug lang pa 'dra/ /lus dor rig pa'i ngo bo ni/ /'od kyi rang bzhin bya sgong tsam/ /shes gtad rlung bzung phaṭa kyis phud/ / dbu ma mthing brgyud spyi bor thon/ /phar la ling nger 'phar ba la/ /shes gtad phaṭa kyis nam mkha' la/ /ngo bo dbyer med 'dres par bsam/ /shin tu che ba'i bem po yang/ /snang srid lha 'dres hab thob byas/ /skye med ngang la ma bcos bzhag /bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis btab/ / ༈ 'phral len dmigs pa 'di ltar bya/ /rang lus tsho snum che bar dmigs/ /spyi bo nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /ṭāk+ki dmar mo rus rgyan can/ /gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa bsnams/ /spyan gsum zhabs gnyis gar stabs can/ / 'khor rigs mang pos bskor ba 'o/ /rang gi snying ga spyi gtsug bar/ /dbu ma phyi dkar gsal ba'i snar/ /shes pa'i ngo bo phaṭa ཿ kyis phud/ /rje btsun ma dang gnyis med gyur/ /bem po shin tu che ba de/ /ṭāk+ki'i phyag gi gri gug gis/ / gtubs nas sha ri khrag mtshor dmigs/ /ṭāk+ki'i thugs las 'od zer 'phros/ / dmar po lcags kyu phaṭa kyis phud/ /snang srid lha 'dre ma lus rnams/ /rang dbang med pa'i bza' btung bcol/ /'dod dgus dgyes shing tshims par bsam/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la bzhag

/ ༈ phyi yi sa dgra'i 'phral len ni/ /chu dang brag dang shing sdong dang*/ /mtsho dkyil gangs kyi rtse mo ru/ /phar phyin dmigs pa lus sbyin bya/ /yang na lcags kyus bkug la byin/ / ༈ rkang rus chen po'i dmigs pa ni/ /snying nang rtsa gnas gong dang 'dra/ /rig pa gong ltar phaṭaḥkyis phud/ /rgyang grag dag gis nam mkha' la/ /sangs kyis phud la mkha' dang bsre/ /bem po shin tu che ba ste/ /che tsho ro drug de bzhin du/ /sha khrag rus dang kha khar phye/ /sha khrag lha 'dres hab thob byas/ /dper na zho rkyal byo ba bzhin/ /tshil bu zhag gis lha 'dre tshims/ /de nas rus pa'i mtho yor la/ /shes gtad phaṭaḥkyis mtho yor 'gyel/ /grangs med gtor la dmigs med bzhag /bu lon lan chags byang bar bsam/ /gnyan sa brgya rtsa gcod pa ni/ /lus bskyed rtsa gnas gong dang 'dra/ /rig pa spyi gtsug phaṭaḥkyis phud/ /nam mkhar rje btsun dmar mor gyur/ /gri gug thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin/ /spyan gsum mche ba yud tsam gtsigs/ / mdun du thod pa'i sgyed gsum btsugs/ /yaṃ raṃ khaṃ gi sa bon gsal/ /raṃ gyis yum chen phyogs nas brgyan/ /nang du bem po gtubs nas blug /yaṃ raṃ khaṃ gi sbyor ba yis/ /rdzas rnams zhu nas ljan ljin po/ /ri brag gnyan sa dur khrod kyi/ / rten gnas gri gug dag gis bcad/ /chu mtsho ka pa la yi bcus/ /bdud rtsir blangs nas sbyangs pa yis/ /gnyis med 'dres pa'i rgya mtshor bsam/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs/ /rje btsun ma dang mkha' spyod nas/ /ṭāk+ki grangs med byon nas gsol/ /lan gsum dag las mang mi bya/ /lhag ma lha 'dre yongs la bkye/ /thod gsum lha 'dre ma lus rnams/ /rje btsun ma la bsdus nas su/ / phaṭaḥkyis stong pa'i ngang la bzhag /dbang sdud 'bros 'gyur ma yang gnyis/ /zhi ba dang ni drag po yis/ /zhi ba la ni 'di skad do/ /rang nyid ma gcig thugs ka nas/ /'od dkar lcags kyu'i rnam pa 'phros/

/snang srid lha 'dre ma lus bsdus// phaṭa kyis rang 'khor bsdus par bsam/ /lan gsum byas nas lus sbyin btang*/ /snying rje'i sems ldan stong nyid bsgom/ /drag pos 'bros gyur dbang sdud ni/ /rang nyid mkha' 'gro nag mor bsgom/ /phaṭaḥkyis snying ga'i 'od zer 'phros/ /'od zer rdo rje'i tsha tsha dang*/ /lcags kyu nag po'i rang bzhin 'phros/ / 'jig rten khams kyi lha 'dre rnams/ /gnas dang bcas pa bkug par bsam// rang dbang med par 'og tu bsdus/ /pha mar dmigs nas lus sbyin btang*// gsum las ma mang skye med bsgom/ / ༈ gal te lus sems bag chags 'thas/ /kun rdzob bden par 'dzin pa la/ /rdzun phug sdib pa'i dmigs pa gces/ khong stong phug stong 'jigs rung du/ /phyin la dur khrod chen por dmigs/ /'dre rgod ro la chas bsu byed/ /ro rul mgo zlum bem po dang*/ /so ma phyed zos keng rus rnams/ /bsam med mgo bo bteg nas blta/ /rang nyid dkyil bsdad tshur la nur/ /ro la rngam pa'i 'dre rgod dang*/ /lce spyang dug sbrul srin mo dang*/ /mi nag mgo bo bcu gcig dang*/ /lag pa bcu gcig seng ge zhon/ /bam gnyis snga sha phyi sha byas/ kha mig mche gtsigs khrag gis brgyan/ /mdun du lag pa nyul nyul byed/ / g.yas su stag zhon de dang mtshungs/ /g.yon du dom zhon lcags sder rno/ /rgyab tu dred zhon spu gri can/ /'jigs gzugs dpag med bstan bsam la/ /phaṭa kyis dbyings dang shes pa bsres/ /bem por hab thob byas pa dmigs/ /bdun dang bcu gcig bar du bya/ /phaṭaḥkyis dmigs med chen por bzhag / ༈ rnal 'byor ting 'dzin bzhag pa la/ /ma bslangs slong pa'i dmigs pa gces/ /rang nyid ma gcig gar stabs can/ /grangs med nam mkha' sa gzhi gang*/ / phaṭaḥkyis sa gzhi khengs par bsam/ /gar stabs phaṭa kyi zhal la 'dri/ /des ni slong bar the tshom med/ /phaṭa med gong gi dmigs pa 'di/ /ma non smyo ba nga rang shes/

/cho 'phrul che na tshar tshad dkon/ / ༈ de la phung po'i thibs non bya/ /rig pa dbyings dang bsres nas su/ /bem po shin tu che bar dmigs/ /bem po sha rus khrag rnams kyis/ /mi ma yin rnams mgo rkang nas/ /'dren nas sdang mig byas par bsam/ /des ni tshar tshad lhur du+u 'ong*/ / ༈ cho 'phrul 'dres nas mgo skor na/ /de la gser gyi lde mig dgos/ / rig pa 'phur nas ṭāk+kir bskyed/ /bem po'i rkang lag gsum bcad de/ /sgyed pur btsugs nas yum chen bkal/ /gnyan sa'i ri brag gri gug gtub/ / chu+u mtsho ka pa la yis bcus/ /bem po dang bcas yal nas su/ /mgron rnams thod skam ṭāk+kir dmigs/ /mchod sbyin gong ltar dgyes pa yis/ /cho 'phrul tshar tshad 'dres pa rnams/ /de yis phyed par the tshom med/ /ma chod chod pa'i mchog yin bya/ /snyan brgyud khong chud gdengs thob kyis/ /rang gzhan gang yang rung ba la/ /dug lnga ma rig 'khrul pa'i nad/ /'bras bu na tsha sdug bsngal rnams/ /sgyu lus phung po ma zhig na/ /'jig rten sgyu mar ma mthong tshe/ /rmi lam dus kyi mtshan nyid bzhin/ /cis kyang na tshe 'byung 'gyur pas/ /bon dang mo ma 'debs pa dang*/ /zas 'dod sman pa sun 'byin pa'i/ /snyan brgyud nad gdon dmigs pa bya/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams kyang*/ /bsdu na gsum du 'dus pa 'o/ /rlung dang tsha ba grang ba gsum/ /de ni rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i nad/ /tsha ba'i nad la 'di ltar bya/ /skyabs 'gro nyi shu rtsa gcig btang*/ /shes pa chos nyid gter du sba/ /bem po'i mdun du seng zhon dmigs/ /mgo bo bcu gcig mig gis gang*/ /lag pa bcu gcig lhu tshig rags/ /na sar zangs sbugs brgyab nas 'jibs/ /lhag ma mi dmigs yongs la bkye/ kha zas drod che sha chang brten/ / bar bar 'khyag pa'i dkyil du dmigs/ / yang gcig kha bsgyur 'di ltar bya/ /nang gi 'byung ba lnga po 'di/ /phyi yi 'byung pa lnga por bstims/

/ngo bo ga pur las byung ba'i/ /chu yi 'khor los ro stod gang*/ /'khyags cing 'dar la shes pa gtad/ /grang ba'i nad la dmigs pa gsum/ /skyabs 'gro lus sbyin gong dang 'dra/ /lte 'og thur zhabs rgyu mthil du/ /sngar gyi seng zhon mgo mang gis/ /lcags kyi thu lum 'bar ba brgyab/ / grang ba'i reg bya ma lus bsreg /rus pa'ang sngo dmar gyur par bsam/ /ma yengs shes gtad rlung sbyor bzung*/ /yang gcig me yi dkyil 'khor du/ / bdag nyid tshud nas tshig la thug /rig pa nang gcun phyir mi dbyung*/ /ting 'dzin gsal na grang ba'i rigs/ /ma lus sel bar the tshom med/ /rlung gi nad la nad rigs gnyis/ /chags sems spang la shes pa glod/ /mi ring seng zhon mgo byas kyis/ /phung khams skye mched sa 'og khyer/ /phag nag 'bum gyis zos par bsam/ /dbang po shes sma da glod la zhog /yang gcig phyi yi 'byung ba lnga/ /nang gi 'byung ba dag la bsdu/ /shes pa 'og sno lta stangs dbyung*/ /ri khrod 'grims na shin tu gces/ /mgo bo na zhing ma bde na/ /mgo bo pad+ma stong du gas/ kha khar gyes la shes pa gtad/ /klad pa bya khyung grangs med kyis/ /zos shing mal yang med par bsam/ /mig nad ling thog ci byung yang*/ /'jigs pa'i seng ge mgo mangs kyis/ /mig gnyis brus nas bya la byin/ /shul du phus btab ltag pa yi/ /sdud sgo'i bar du har re dmigs/ /bem po byin la skye med bsgom/ /

cham pa ya mas sna 'tshubs na/ /sbrul nag gdug pa gnyis kyis ni/ /sna bug gnyis nas 'dzul pa yis/ /mtshul khung sna ni ma lus rnams/ /zos 'jib rang sar yal bar bsam/ /skye med ngang la ma bcos bzhag /rna ba 'on dang gzer sogs la/ /'jigs pa'i seng zhon rgyab nas byung*/ /sdigs mdzub lcags sreg 'bar ba yis/ /rna bug gnyis su brgyab pa yis/ /phar thal tshur thal bsreg par bsam/ /lus po byin la spros med bzhag /gang zhig lce bud na dang skyug /stag zhon mgo mang mdun byung nas/ /lce ni shar ma bcu gcig byas/ /bcu gcig kha ru bcug nas 'jibs/ /lus sbyin byas nas skye med bsgom/ /so la srin bus na ba la/ /seng zhon mgo byas 'jigs pa lnga/ /so la phreng ba ga shal byas/ /lhag ma lha 'dre yongs la bkyes/ /gag pa'i dmigs pa 'di bzhin bya/ /bya khyung me yi gshog pa can/ /spyang ki sngon mo lcags kyi mgo / pho rog ser po gser mig can/ /sbrul nag gdug pa'i lce dug can/ /de bzhis mgo byas bsam 'das kyis/ /nad dang sha khrag bcas pa zos/ /shul yang ma lus skye med bsgoms/ /mid 'chus mid skyug na ba la/ /mi nag zhe sdang sbrul gyi mgo kha nas 'dzul nas pho bar slebs/ /pho ba mid sha la bcas pa zos/ /thu lum sprul nas shul yang bsregs/ /lhag ma khyung gis ma bzhag zos/ /mid 'chus phan par the tshom med/ / glo ba rnag gis khengs nas na/ /mi nag dred dang stag zhon gyis/ /ol gong dras nas rnag khung 'jib/ kho dga' yal ler shes pa gtad/ /stod kyi gzer dmigs khrol tshags dmigs/ /bu gar nad rnams sngo dmar thon/ /lud pa mchil ma gdon la bsngo/ /mchin pa'i nad kyis gdung gin na/ /gnam lcags rdo rje rgya gram gyis/ /mar la lcags sreg rgyab pa bzhin/ /mchin pa'i dkyil du bskor ba yis/ /mer gyis zhu nas khrag tu song*/ /khwa ta seng ge stag zhon gyis/ /zangs ma'i sbu gu gtad nas 'jibs/ /res dga' khyi nag 'bum gyis zos/

/skran la mi nag mgo mang gis/ /thu lum 'bar ba rgyab nas zhu/ / seng zhon mi khyis za 'thung dang*/ khyung dang sbrul la za res bab/ /snying nad snying rlung gdon 'dre zhugs/ /smyo dang shes pa dran stor la/ /snying ni tshon skud sna lngas dkris/ /sems ni mar me lta bur bsam/ /de la ma yengs gnad nas sel/ /yang gcig 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur/ /de'i nang ma gcig tshon gang bskyed/ /ma gcig thugs kar gser gyi ni/ /rdo rje langs nas yod pa la/ / rig pa gtad la snying rje bsgoms/ /snying nad 'joms par the tshom med/ /pho nad zas mi 'ju+u ba la/ /mi nag mgo mang 'jigs pa yis/ /pho kha brtol te 'jibs nas zos/ /tha mar sha sbrang pho ba 'gengs/ /pho ba nad bcas zos par dmigs/ /rlung gnyis kha sbyor bzung la skye med bsgoms/ / ༈ mcher nad dmigs pa 'di bzhin no/ /mcher par lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /zhu nas dom zhon sbu gus 'jibs/ /de yang mang byas rtog med gces/ /rgyu ma khrag bshal bzod med la/ /rang nyid spros med ngang la bzhag /mdun du khyi spyang pho rog gis/ /rgyu ma phar 'then tshur 'then byed/ /shing rtse brag zur dag la dkris/ /rlung gnyis kha sbyor mchong 'khrab bya/ /nad zhi skye med gdings dang ldan/ /long srin long dug na ba la/ /lcags sreg 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ / rno ba'i ngar ldan long phug 'khor/ /nad dang long ka bcas pa zhu/ /lce spyang 'bum gyis 'thungs nas dgyes/ /mkhal nad mkhal rtsa grang mkhal la/ /bya khyung me yi gshogs can gyis/ /mkhal ma tshil dang bcas pa zos/ /gshogs pa brdabs pas shul yang bsregs/ /rtsa rgyud gang du mi dmigs btang*/ /des ni zhi bar the tsho med/ / lhen dang gsang nad rlig lug la/ /seng zhon 'jigs pa'i mi nag gis/ / sgong ril gnyis phyung byi lar byin/ /shul du lcags sdong 'bar gnyis bcug / khog smad lcags sreg dmar ngad la/ /shes gtad rlung bzung the tshom med/

/ rtsa chu 'gag pa'i nad byung na/ /lus mdor khung lnga'i mkhar zhig brtsigs/ / bdag gi nor bus brgyan par gces/ /gtan du bzhugs zha ེ sa gsol ba gtab/ /de yis spong bar the tsho med/ / ༈ bas ེ na mos thig le 'phrog pa la/ /nor bus 'jig rten gang bar bsam/ /bas ེ na mo nor bu'i rtse la bskyon/ /nor bu langs pa'i rtse mor khyer/ / nam mkha'i dbyings nas gzhan du 'phangs/ /rgya mtsho'i gting du dngos med song*/ /yang gcig gang rmis mdza' mor bskyed/ /gtan du mdza' grogs byed par bsam/ /gtan du lhan nyal lus sbyin bya/ /yid la chags na skye med bsgom/ /bar bar rdo rje'i dmigs pa bya/ /des ni mi 'phrog nyams myong yod/ / gzhang 'brum gnye ma za zhing khrol/ /rkub nad gnye mar srin bu ni/ /ser po mgo dmar grangs med bsam/ /gnye ma srin 'bu bcas pa rnams/ khyung gis zos par yang yang dmigs/ /rkang lag lhu tshigs na ba la/ /sbrul nag 'dom dgu pa zhig gis/ /na ba'i rkang lag bcings par dmigs/ /bar bar lus sbyin snying rje bsgom/ /rkang dang rus pa khol ba na/ /'jigs pa'i rkang lag lhu rags kyis/ /gnam lcag s+t+wa gris gtub nas ni/ /rkang mar rus dang bcas pa rnams/ /snang srid lha 'dre yongs la bkye/ /rjes med spros bral ngang la bzhag /rkang lag zha nad gzhug gcod kyi/ /dmigs pa sbrul gyis ltems se gang*/ /bya khyung dmar nag dpag med kyis/ /sbrul dang bdag po lhan du zos/ /lhag ma ma lus sgyu lus sbyangs/ /gang zhig mo nad na ba la/ /bu snod nang du zla ba gsal/ / zla ba zhu nas bdud rtsir gyur/ /rtsa rgyud 'grims nas lus kun gang*/ / dga' bdes lus mchong yang yang byed/ /rgyung par zhugs nas khengs par bsam/ /gzhung tshigs nang du nyi ma 'bum/ /chu ser nyi ma'i 'od la thim/ /lus sbyin skye med ngang du bzhag /srog rlung srog rtsa 'chus pa la/ /dred zhon lag ring byung nas su/ /bshang lam dag tu lag pa brkyang*/

/srog rtsa 'then nas sa 'og khyer/ /gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du zos/ /sa 'og lha 'dre'i sna grangs g.yos/ / lus kun zos nas sa 'og song*/ /srog rlung 'joms par the tshom med/ /mkhris nad mkhris pa mig ser la/ /mi nag bya khyung lcags mchu can/ /mchin kha brtol nas mkhris pa 'joms/ /lhag ma bya nag 'bum gyis zos/ /skye med sgom pa man ngag yin/ / ༈ bad kan spyi khyab na ba la/ /a dkar dag gis lus kun gang*/ /lus sbyin dkar tshogs mchog tu shis/ /mdze pho gso na 'di ltar ro/ /lus gdon gtsor byas sems can rnams/ /snying rjes lus sbyin grangs med byed/ /de nas rang lus mgo mjug nas/ /sbrul nag lcags kyi ze ba can/ /g.yas g.yon sbrul 'jigs sngo ser gnyis/ /mdun rgyab sbal pa dkar nag gnyis/ /bya khyung bsam gyis mi khyab bsam/ /gcan gzan dpag med 'dus nas su/ /res mos byas nas zos par bsam/ /slob dpon ting 'dzin ldan pa yis/ /nad pa'i sems dang rang sems gnyis/ /dbyer med chos nyid gter du sba/ /rma shu rma ro bem po la/ /klu tshang dmigs nas snying rje bsgom/ / rjes gcod dmigs pa 'di bzhin bya/ khyung dmar me yi gshogs pa can/ / grangs med dag la drag pos sbyin/ /nad dang mgron rigs ma lus rnams/ kha dog bsgyur ba shin tu gces/ /rgyal 'gong snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mang*/ /de gcod man ngag shin tu gces/ /btsun chen mi rings dgu 'bum dang*/ /bshan pa spu gri rno thogs 'bum/ /gcan gzan stag gzig bsam 'das la/ /lus sbyin snying rje drag po skyed/ /rang sar yal nas skye med bsgom/ /rmu bdud btsan gyi nad byung na/ /gri thogs bshan pa grangs med dang*/ /g.yag nag po la me stag 'phro/ /brdungs shing sha rus phye mar btang*/ /mi nag gri thogs 'bum phrag dang*/ /rta dmar zhon pa drug 'bum gyis/ /zos nas sha yang med par dmigs/ /gnyan dang sa bdag nad la ni/ /glang dmar me stag 'phro ba gcig/

sbal pa khra bo stobs chen gsum/ /glang dmar rwa ring brdungs nas su/ /sbrul nag gdug pa lce dug can/ /sbal sbrul bzhi pos mgo byas nas/ /snang srid lha 'dres zos par dmigs/ /snying rje che na pos skye med bsgom/ /drang srong nad kyis zin pa la/ /gza' bdud nag po mgo dgu pa/ /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen brgyad/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ /gdong mo che bzhi la sogs dang*/ /sdong zla lha srin sde brgyad la/ /lus po gtubs nas yang yang sbyin/ /skye med spros bral ngang la bzhag / lhog rgod byung na 'di ltar byed/ /rang lus lcags kyi rdo rje bsam/ /lha 'dre rang dang gnyis med bskyed/ /'o dod 'bod cing drag pos 'dul/ /'brum pa byung na lus sbyin bya/ /rtse mo btogs la kha ru bcug kha zas mi cho bshan pa 'dra/ /rtog med ngang la nyam nga med/ /da ni gcod log bcos thabs bstan/ / bla ma'i snyan brgyud ma thob par/ /spyod pa rtsing zhing drag gcod byed/ /nyams len dor nas yid 'dzin smyo/ /spyod tho che ba shan pa 'dra/ /dam tshig mi bsrung 'chol bar spyod/ /cho 'phrul byung na man ngag med/ /smyo dang na tsha shes pa sdar/ / des na mi 'dod dpag med 'byung*/ /de ni log par bya ba yin/ /gzhan yang log pa 'di ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas sgrub par ma shes nas/ /mthu rtsal gtam snyan khe grags bsgrubs/ /'dre dang nad gnyis phan 'dod na/ /de ni log pa chen po yin/ /mi log sgo gtan lta bu ni/ /sngar gyi gnyan sar log la bcad/ / bla ma'i chos la nan tan bskyed/ /lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul sems su bcad/ / skye med ngang du ma bcos bzhag /gzhan yang tha dad dmigs pa ni/ /rig pa phud la ḍāk+kir bskyed/ /phaṭa brjod ḍāk+ki'i thugs ka nas/ /mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas tho ba/ /g.yon pa lcags kyu bzung pa yang*/ /grangs med spros pas sde brgyad rnams/ /lcags kyus bzung nas tho bas bcom/ /bu ga sgo dgu ha re bar/

/bsam nas sgo ru raṃ dmar res/ / bcad nas lus dang 'dres par bsam/ /rtsa rnams raṃ gyi phreng bar bsam/ /bol gong gnyis nas gnyis gnyis dang*/ /mthe bong gnyis nas yaṃ gnyis bsgom/ /yaṃ raṃ brjod pas ṭāk+ki ma'i/ / thugs rje'i raṃ yaṃ zung zhig 'phros/ /de la phog pas yaṃ raṃ gnyis/ /me rlung gis sbyangs thal bar btang*/ /thun thun ṭāk+ki'i thugs ka nas/ /yaṃ byung rlung gis stor nas su/ /baṃ gyi chus bkrus skye med bsgom/ /srog la thug na min mi bya/ / brag la lhongs kyi dmigs pa ni/ /rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo ni/ /gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyis/ /brag ri rmang nas bshig par bsam/ /gnas pa'i lha 'dre ma lus kun/ /rang dbang med par zhabs su chud/ /bka' nyan gsung sdod byed par bsam/ /ri bo chen po ma bslangs na/ /seng ge stobs ldan 'gyings ba yis/ /ri rgyal rtse nas rmang du bshig /gnas pa'i lha 'dre 'og tu 'dus/ /bka' nyan gsung sdod byed par bsam/ /mtsho ma bslangs na rig pa ni/ khros pas me yi bya khyung gyur/ /gshog pa sder mo me ru 'bar/ /mtsho la hub btab drang bar bsam/ /gnas pa'i klu srin dbang du bsdus/ /snying rje chen pos lus sbyin bya/ / shing gcig gnyen pos ma bslangs na/ /rig pa dbal s+t+wa yan par gyur/ /shing sdong shing phung rtsad nas bcad/ /lha 'dre zhabs su tshud par dmigs/ /bka' nyan gsung sdod byed par bsam/ /shing nag 'thug por nyal ba'i dus/ /rig pa ral gri ngar ldan gyis/ /'phro bcad sbom bshig gang yang med/ /gnas pa'i lha 'dre 'og tu 'dus/ /snying rje drag pos lus sbyin bya/ /chu mig ma bslangs mtha' gtad ni/ /rig pa rje btsun dmar mo yis/ /chu mig dkrugs nas hub kyis btab/ /yul mi gcig sar 'pho bar bsam/ /shul med gram pa skam por dmigs/ /klu chen 'og tu chos nyan bsam/ /sa phug gad phug dag tu ni/ / rig pa thu lum 'bar ba yis/ /rmang du bshigs nas 'dus par bsam/

/snying rje drag pos lus sbyin bya/ /lam srang brag srang rgya lam dang*/ /gong bu mdo stong dag tu ni/ /rig pa rdo brag rir ma dper mi gsal/ /brag srub rgyu lam thams cad bcad/ /gnas pa'i lha 'dre dbang du bsdus/ /lung gsum 'dus pa'i mdo ru ni/ /rig pa khro bo stobs chen gyur/ /sprul pa'i rdzu 'phrul dpag med kyis/ /ri rgyal rtse mo man chad nas/ /gnam sa ri brag thams cad kyi/ /sde brgyad ma lus dbang du bsdus/ /bka' nyan gsung sgrub byed par dmigs/ / rdul du song nas lha 'dre rnams/ /rang gi 'og tu 'dus par bsam/ /steng gdon 'og gdon mtha' gtad ni/ /nad pa'i ske la yugs sa yi/ /skra shad thag nag rgyab par dmigs/ /chu dang mtsho yi dkyil du ni/ /klu rgyal rnams la sne mo gtad/ / gdug pa'i klu dang 'brel bar bsam/ /rig pa bem po'i lpags pa bshus/ / phyes se bting la lcags sreg gi /sa gzhir gyur pa'i steng du ni/ /sha khrag rus gsum ma lus blug /gza' klu+u sa bdag steng du bsam/ /thams cad phul bas tshims par bsam/ /brag shing pha bong lha khang rnams/ /thag nag dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra/ /sbrel nas gtan 'dug skye med gces/ / ༈ drag po'i thu lum dmigs pa ni/ /bar bar lcags kyi sa gzhir bsam/ / rig pa bem po'i lpags pa bshus/ /rang gis thu lum 'bar ba yis/ /dbyings nas 'char ba'i sha khrag dang*/ /lha 'dre bcar ba'i dkyil du rgyab/ /lpags pa lcags sreg 'ub kyis bsdus/ /rgyu ma sbrul gyi chun por bltas/ /nang du thu lum 'bar ba yis/ /sha khrag btso bkol byas par dmigs/ /rjes ni skye med ngang la bzhag / gcod log sna khrag ma chod nas/ /sna khrag byung na gtor ma bsngo/ /lus dang bcas nas sbyin par btang*/ /rgyab lag byas nas mchong 'khrab bya/ /mtha' gtad gong gi drag po bya/ /gnyan sar pho log byung ba na/ /log pa'i rtags yin chu ru bkrus/ khrus chu ri brag shing la gtor/

/yang ni glo bur chu thor byung*/ /log pa'i rtags yin de grangs kyi/ /rde 'u chu mig nang du bskyur/ / yang cig glo bur gzer byung na/ /gang nar rdo rje gzir nas mnan/ /ma zhi mtha' gtad dmigs pa gces/ /glo bur skran dang chus gang na/ /thu lum 'bar bas lus po kun/ /zang thal phug nas tshogs su za/ /lhag ma byin dang skye med bsgom/ /glo bur me dbal tshad pa la/ /snying na 'khyags pa mthe bong gang*/ / je cher song bas mgo lus khengs/ /'khyags par dmigs nas ha ring 'don/ / glo bur grang ba'i nad byung na/ /drug mdor me stag rnon por bsgom/ /me ru 'bar bas byang khog gang*/ /mgar gyi tsha tsha 'phro bar bsam/ /de gnyis mtha' gtad go zlog bya/ khol bu'i nad la phug par dmigs/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum zang thal du/ /phar 'gro tshur 'gror shes pa gtad/ /lus sbyin skye med ngang la bzhag/ skyur nad za ma mi len na/ /mid nang sha yis bcad par bsam/ /pho ba sha sbrang rnams kyis zos/ /lus sbyin bya zhing nad la blta/ / bshal rjes 'chos log non pa ni/ /rgyu zhabs ru trās bcings par bsgom/ /de rnams mtha' gtad log non no/ / gdon can dag la byin rlob na/ /bla ma'i mos gus yid la bsgom/ /sor mo gcan gzan lnga ru bsgom/ /mgor bzhag nad pa'i lus zos nas/ / sems ni rang sems dag la bstim/ /byis pa bsam med bem po rnams/ / dmigs pa rang gi bem rig bral/ /sha khrag lha 'dre yongs la bkye/ /gcan gzan mang pos zos par bsam/ /gdon gyi dmigs pa zhal las shes/ /rgyal pos mgo bskor byung ba na/ /rig pa rje btsun dmar mor bskyed/ /thod pa gri gug dag gis bcad/ /gdon dang lus po bcas pa yang*/ /phaṭa dang bcas pas thod par blug /rmi lam gang byung thod par sbyar/ /byin gyis brlabs nas sngar bzhin gsol/ /sa bdag mgo bskor byung ba na/ /rig pa ṭāk+ki gong dang 'gre/ /bem po gri gug dag gis bshas/ /sha rus lpags pa brta ba yis/

/ gnyan sa sha khrag rus lpags kyis/ /gtibs nas 'gul 'khyog med par bsam/ /bdun las mang ba mi rung ngo*/ /btsan gyis mgo skor byung ba na/ /bem rig mi 'bral ril bskyur bya/ kho dga' 'dod pa tshims par bsam/ /grang bas byas pa myur du chod/ /mdze log shi la thug pa yang*/ /sbal sbrul gnyis dang nya lcong gnyis/ /sdig sdom gnyis te drug po yis/ /g.yas g.yon yan lag gzhan rnams zos/ /mdun rgyab sdig pa dkar nag gnyis/ /sbrul nag mgo dgu pa zhig gis/ /mgo nas zos pas rting par thug /rting pa nas zos mgo la thug /lus ni dra ba'i tshul du btang*/ /'phro ma za mkhan bcas pa rnams/ /me yi bya khyung grangs 'das kyis/ /zos shing shul yang med par bsam/ /mdze nad log par mi srid do/ / ༈ 'bras dang za log dmigs pa ni/ /na sar rdo rje rgya gram dmigs/ /rgya gram dkyil du bud mchu bud/ khrag rul chu ser rnag khrag rnams/ /'gul skyod byas pas 'bab par bsam/ /rdo rje rnon po 'khor bar dmigs/ /lus sbyin bya zhing skye med bsgoms/ /'go nad mgor 'gro'i dmigs pa ni/ /rta rtog mi bya sngas su phyin/ /nad dri kha rlangs bdugs nas su/ /dbu mar bstims shing khengs nas kyang*/ /lus dang bcas pa yal bar bsam/ /rtog pa mi bya mtshan du nyal/ /na yul na mkhan ngo bo gsum/ /stong pa'i ngang la chams kyis bzhag / gal te rjes nyams byung ba na/ /rjes kyi brag dang ri la ni/ /rig pa gser gyi rdo rje 'bum/ /phaṭa kyis phud nas ri brag rnams/ /zang thal drwa bar btang ba dmigs/ /chu mtsho dkrug cing rtsi shing rnams/ /rdul du btang ba'i dmigs pa bya/ /snying rjes lus sbyin shin tu gces/ /gsum las mang ba mi rung ngo*/ khyi dang gcan gzan dngos su byung*/ /gces 'dzin glod la mdun du nyal/ khyi gcan pha ma dngos su bsam/ /bem po stong pa'i ngang la bzhag /snying rjes 'jigs yul gtan la dbab/ /mi gcod dmigs pa bsdus pa ni/

/mda' mdung mtshon cha'i char phabs kyang*/ /bem rig phral la stong par bzhag /mda' rdo 'od gsal rang gi sems/ /mda' mkhan stong gzugs bde ba'i ngang*/ /phaṭa kyis gnyis med ro mnyam dbyings/ /de yis chod par the tshom med/ /ro gcod dmigs pa dril ba ni/ /rang nyid khros ma dmar mo ni/ /phar mchong tshur 'phyong phaṭa kyis g.yengs/ /de ni ro 'dul dmigs pa 'o/ /de nas rngam la nyams len bskyangs/ /mi ro rang dang gcig tu bsre/ /phaṭa kyis rig pa gter du sba/ /lha 'dre yongs la tshims par sbyin/ /'jigs na rang gi ro la 'jigs/ /'jigs yul 'jigs mkhan rtsa brdar bcad/ /'khrul pa bden med sgyu mar bsgom/ / stong nyid rig pa'i rtsal sbyong gces/ /mtsho dkyil dmigs pa gtong lugs ni// mtsho dkyil rdo rje brag chen bkod/ /steng du 'gyur med pho brang gdab/ /pu shu khra la ba gam khyung*/ /nyi zla'i phibs la gser tog yum/ /nang du sbyin bdag gar mkhan ma/ /klu bdud lha 'dre ma lus bsdus/ /tshogs 'khor snying rjes 'gro ba 'dren/ /gdan du bzhugs nas skye med bsgom/ / chu bos khyer ram byings pa na/ /rmi lam dus kyi mtshang rig bzhin/ /stong nyid rig pa mdung bskor bya/ /rlung bzung rig pa phaṭa kyis phud/ /'khrul snang sgyu ma bden med bsgom/ /me la gcod dgos byung ba na/ /me dang rang nyid stong par bsam/ /me lce'i tsha zer phog pa'i tshe/ /chos nyid rang 'od stong par bsre/ / me sgra gzhom med sgyu mar bsgom/ /snyems med stong pa'i ngang la bzhag /de yis chod par the tshom med/ /g.yang la lhung la phaṭa kyis phud/ /bem po bal gyi phung por bsgoms/ /gar babs mar gyi thang du bsam/ /snyems med stong pa'i ngang la bzhag /gnam lcags thog gi dmigs pa ni/ /rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo ni/ / gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu dmigs/ /phaṭa kyis nam mkha'i dbyings su phud/ / thogs dang thogs med thogs bdag bcas/

/phar 'jug tshur 'jug drwa bar btang*/ /rdo rje'i 'od la ma lus thims/ /yal nas stong pa'i ngang la bzhag / yang gcig rang nyid ṭāk+kir bsgoms/ /phaṭa kyis thugs kar lcags kyi ni/ /rdo rje rtse dgu mkha' la song*/ /thogs bdag thogs dang thogs med rnams/ /rdo rje'i 'od la thims nas babs/ /'dug pa'i gzhi bdag yin pa la/ /nas phung dkyil du rdo rgyab bzhin/ /nyil gyis stor bas grangs med bya/ /yang na thu lum 'bar ba yis/ /rang dang gnyan sa lhan du brdal/ /stong nyid ma bcos ngang du bzhag /thog ser sbrag ma'i dmigs pa ni/ /'og tu nyi ma zla ba ste/ /nyi zla'i ga 'u kha sbyor rnams/ /rang rang yul zhing 'khor bcas rnams/ /lha 'dre dang bcas gang bar dmigs/ /zla ba'i steng du ma gcig dang*/ /yi dam sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /sprin ltar 'khrigs la shes pa gtad/ /dkar tshogs lus sbyin gong dang mtshungs/ /glog 'brug thog 'od stong par bsgoms/ /des ni 'ong bar mi srid do/ / da ni spyi ching nyams len dmigs pa ni/ /sems byung rnam rtog thams cad kyang*/ /stong pa nyid kyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs yin/ /skyon med rang so nyid du zhog / rtsa bral gzhi med rang sar grol bar nges/ /chags shing sdang nyams gang dag byung na yang*/ /gang shar ngo bos bzung nas phaṭa kyi ngang*/ /de rang 'dzin med ma bcos ngang la bzhag /ma yengs glod pas rang sar dag par nges/ /ma rung lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang*/ /rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba bden med yin/ /

bden 'dzin thongs la lus po ltos med byin/ /'jigs dang ya nga bag tsha bral bar nges/ /na tsha zug gzer sdug bsngal ci byung yang*/ /sngon gyi las 'bras sgyu ma lta bu yin/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar smon lam btab/ /skyon dag yon tan dag dang mjal bar nges/ /'byung ba 'khrug pa'i na tsha ci byung yang*/ /rjes la gsol ba btab cing nad las grol/ /bltas pas mthong med nam mkha' stong pa 'dra/ / skye med grogs su shar bar nges so ang*/ /'chi 'o snyam pa rnam rtog kho na yin/ / snyems med yo langs rtog pa rang sar yal/ /skye med chos sku'i ngo bor lhun gyis grub/ /gnyis med 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod pa yin/ /de rnams rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor ri khrod nas/ /dgag sgrub med par re dogs g.yang sa chod/ /'khor ba'i btson nas thar ba'i grong mchog slebs/ /sku gsum 'gyur med rgyal sa zin pa yin/ /bogs 'don 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor sgom chen tsho/ /'di ni bogs 'don mchog ste ngo sprod rgyal po yin/ /snying gtam mchog ste gegs sel mthar thug yin/ /gzhan la mi ster rang nyid nyams su longs/ /lnga brgyar gyur pa'i sems can zhe sdang che/ /snod ldan dkon pas lha 'dre thub tshod byed/ /rang sdig ma gsogs tsit+ta'i nang du sbos/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gcod pa'i ming 'dogs mang*/ /rang gi rang bslus gzhan yang zhor la bslu/ /rang grol gnyug ma'i 'od gsal mi shes par/ /bsgom chen yin zer nyams kyis phyir phyir rgyas/ /rig pa'i gnad kyis grol tshul mi shes par/ / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i khas len byed/ /rnam rtog 'khrul pa rang sar ma chod par/ /gcod mkhan yin zer lha 'dre ar la gtad/ /smyo gcod tho co srin po dag dang mtshungs/ /de rnams snod min shin tu gsang bar bya/ / 'o na bstan pa'i snod ni gang zhe na/ /gdung sems skyo shas snying rje can la bstan/ /rang tshig grags 'dod chags sdang can la gsang*/

/zhen log dka' thub snying rus can la bstan/ /nang stong phyi ldir zog po'i rigs la gsang*/ / snyan brgyud gzhung lnga yan lag brgya sum cu/ /khrig chags tshang ba'i yig ris med na 'ang*/ /pha yab bud+dha dzñā na'i gsung bzhin du/ /lhag chad med par bris so rdzogs pa yin/ /'dir ni dmigs pa brgya dang nyi shu yod/ /nag sbyor ha la nag po'i dmigs pa gtso bo ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// // maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)gcod kyi spyi khrid chen mo/ - PAGE 270 -- PAGE 269 -- PAGE 249 -
